_comment: Single source of truth for model tiers. Role files declare `tier:`, never a model name. scripts/sync-agent-config.sh resolves tier -> claude model; scripts/codex-review.sh resolves tier -> codex model.

deep.rationale: Errors here are the most expensive to unwind — they propagate through every later stage.

standard.rationale: Work constrained by an approved spec and architecture; mistakes surface in review or CI.

cheap.rationale: Transcription and mechanical work against a fixed input.

escalation._comment: On rework attempt N >= 2 a role runs one tier deeper, so cheap models get first crack and expensive ones only see hard cases. Escalation is sticky and does not decay: a role reworked once stays escalated for the rest of the work item. That is deliberate — a work item that needed rework once has shown itself to be the hard kind. The ladder tops out after one step, so there is no runaway; scripts/wp-append.sh stops the run after three attempts instead.

_codex_note: Codex model slugs are the full ids from `codex` model metadata (see ~/.codex/models_cache.json). Bare 'sol'/'terra'/'luna' are rejected by the API.
